name: Lunate Dislocation
definition: Carpal dislocation in which the lunate loses alignment with the radius/capitate, often producing acute median nerve compression.

investigations.principle: Radiographs establish diagnosis; CT defines associated fractures.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Definitive ligamentous repair/stabilization is usually required.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha Sandhi displacement phenotype may be documented after emergency reduction.

patientEducation.summary: Carpal dislocation in which the lunate loses alignment with the radius/capitate, often producing acute median nerve compression.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
